PASSWORD_WEAK: The password must be at least {{min_length}} characters and contain both letters and digits
INVITE_CODE_REQUIRED: An invite code is required to sign up
INVITE_CODE_INVALID: The invite code is invalid, used up or expired
INVITE_CODE_LIMIT_REACHED: At most {{max}} invite codes can be kept at once. Revoke unused ones first
RENEWAL_CODE_INVALID: The renewal code is invalid, used up or expired
RENEWAL_CODE_ALREADY_REDEEMED: You've already redeemed this renewal code

CLIENT_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED: This Looklook version is too old. Please update to {{latest_version}} first

KEY_REVOKED: Your sign-in is no longer valid. Please sign in again
KEY_ROTATION_NOT_FOUND: The operation expired. Please try again
TUNNEL_LIMIT_REACHED: At most {{max}} local pages can be added

rule.charset: may only use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens
rule.range: is out of the allowed range
rule.mailbox: must be in the form Name <email>
rule.host_scheme: Enter the host only, without http:// or https://
rule.host_port: Don't include a port (e.g. :1234); Looklook decides the port
rule.host_path: Enter the host only; no /, spaces or similar characters
rule.host_ip: The IP address is incomplete or incorrect, e.g. 192.168.1.20
rule.host_unusable: This address can't be used to open a page (e.g. 0.0.0.0). Enter the machine's actual IP
rule.host_name: Invalid format: only letters, digits, hyphens and dots, e.g. nas.local
rule.ip_prefix: Invalid prefix length; IPv4 uses /8 to /32
rule.ip_too_wide: Range too wide; it can't be opened to the whole internet
rule.ip_loopback: This computer can already open it itself; no need to add
rule.ip_too_many: The allowlist holds at most 32 entries
rule.code_length: The access code must be 8 to 64 characters
rule.file_name: can’t be empty, contain / \ or other special characters, or be . or ..
rule.relative: must be a path inside the repository
rule.private_key: isn’t an OpenSSH / PEM private key (it should start with -----BEGIN … PRIVATE KEY-----)
rule.ppk: is a PuTTY (.ppk) key — export it to OpenSSH format in PuTTYgen first
rule.jump_required: — “Via jump host” needs a jump host
rule.jump_loop: can’t lead back to this host

LAN_SWITCH_OFF: Switching to the local network is turned off (Settings → Access)
DEVICE_TIMEOUT: This computer didn't answer in time; retrying
CLIENT_UNREACHABLE: Can't reach Looklook on this computer; it may have quit
REMOTE_FORBIDDEN: This action can only be done on this computer or the LAN
PORT_RESERVED: {{port}} is used by Looklook itself. Pick another number
WORKDIR_DENIED: No permission to use folder: {{path}}. Pick another folder or grant access to it
TTYD_MISSING: The installation is incomplete and the terminal component is missing. Please reinstall Looklook
NO_FREE_PORT: Too many terminals are running. Stop some first
NO_TMUX: The background-session component isn't available on this computer
OFFLINE_TOO_LONG: Haven't reached the Looklook server for a long time

ACCESS_CODE_REQUIRED: Enter the access code first (refresh the page to see the input box)
SHELL_NOT_FOUND: Couldn't find the shell "{{shell}}" on this computer. Check the name or enter the full path.
UPDATE_BUSY: An update is already in progress.
UPDATE_NONE: You're already on the latest version.
UPDATE_UNSUPPORTED: This installation can't update itself. Download the new version from the download page.
UPDATE_DOWNLOAD_FAILED: Downloading the update failed. Check your network and try again. ({{detail}})
UPDATE_CHECKSUM: The downloaded file failed verification (possibly incomplete). Please try again.
UPDATE_FAILED: Installing the update failed; your current version is unchanged. ({{detail}})
AGENT_NOT_FOUND: This AI assistant wasn't found on this computer; install it first
MCP_DISABLED: Turn on "Allow AI assistants to add pages" first
DSH_EXISTS: DSH is already set up on this computer; open it from the terminal list
DSH_NEEDS_PERSISTENT: DSH needs terminals that keep running in the background, which this computer doesn't support
MODEL_DISCLAIMER_REQUIRED: Please read and accept the disclaimer first
MODEL_URL_UNSUPPORTED: Unsupported endpoint: it must start with https:// and the path may only contain letters, digits and - . _ ~ /
MODEL_PROVIDER_GONE: This provider is no longer available for this client. Refresh and choose again.
FILE_EXISTS: A file or folder with that name already exists. Pick another name.
GIT_MISSING: Git isn’t installed on this computer. Install Git and try again.
GIT_NOT_REPO: This folder isn’t a Git repository.
